name: Dutch Bros Decaf Americano with Steamed Oat Milk
whyItWorks: Decaffeinated espresso diluted with hot water and topped with creamy oat milk. Dilution lowers titratable acidity, while eliminating 99% of caffeine prevents colonic contractions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Decaf Americano with a splash of oat milk, unflavored and unsweetened.'
